name: Draft Horse
publisher: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Adventurers League
author: Robert Alaniz
heading: Draft Horse
errataEvidence: The official publisher errata index does not list a correction for this adventure.
habitatEvidence: This adventure places its draft horses at the front of a fortified trade caravan on p. 11.
appearanceEvidence: The appearance summarizes the selected image and uses the printed encounter description where supplied.
sourceNotes: The p. 26 stat block gives Large size and AC 10. P. 11 uses “huge” descriptively and explicitly calls the horses Large. Barding, cover and the narrow formation are chase details.
The p. 11 chase uses an end-of-turn Constitution check starting in round five, DC 10 and increasing by 1 each later round. Roll once per wagon team. This is encounter procedure.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
publisher: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Adventurers League
author: Ken Hart
heading: Giant Wolf Spider
errataEvidence: The official publisher errata index does not list a correction for this adventure.
habitatEvidence: The A Sticky Situation encounter on pp. 12–13 uses this spider as a weaker alternative to an ettercap.
appearanceEvidence: The appearance summarizes the selected image and uses the printed encounter description where supplied.
sourceNotes: The Giant Wolf Spider statistics end the left column of p. 26. Its traits and Bites continue at the top of the right column before Needle Blight.

The continuation calls the subject “the swarm” in its traits and titles the action Bites. The summary uses the named spider as the subject and preserves the printed action title and numbers. The 2014 Giant Wolf Spider is a comparison witness and gives the same trait and attack mechanics.
The Swarm of Spiders has a separate stat block on pp. 27–28. Its Bites attack has 0-ft. reach and damage that depends on its remaining hit points.
